characters.name: thor
characters.description: Thor — the singer/narrator. Adult man, contemplative gaze, present and grounded. Aesthetic: wintry/poetic/noir palette (cool silvers, deep blues, candlelight warmth). Mood: introspective, listening to bells in the frozen night.

environments.name: silver_bells
environments.description: Extreme close-up of antique silver bells, hanging in cold air. Frost rimes the bell shoulders. Slight pendulum motion frozen in time. Black background, dramatic chiaroscuro, single cold light from above. Surreal, painterly.

environments.name: frozen_branches
environments.description: Black bare tree branches encrusted in ice and snow, against a dark indigo sky. Tiny ice crystals catch starlight. The branches form a delicate, almost glass-like structure. No people, no buildings. Surreal painterly stillness.

shots.description: Antique silver bells in deep darkness, frost on their shoulders, the faintest sway as if breathed on by cold air.
Thor's face against black, lit cold from above. He begins the line: "Hear the silver bells in the frozen air..." Mouth motion only; the rest of him is still as stone.
Black ice-encrusted branches against indigo night, ice crystals catching starlight. Almost glass, almost lace. The slow rotation suggests we are turning beneath them.
shots.framing: medium, looking up through the branches

shots.description: Cut back to Thor as he finishes the line: "...how they tinkle and tinkle through the night." His expression has shifted — quieter, more haunted.
